description:
Cloud18 licence — WARN0315, WARN0316, ERR00122

Carries the instance's Cloud18 licence: its URI <company>.<expiry YYYYMM>.<seat> is set when the plugin is built, so the plugin's signature covers it. Delivered in the licence package (git pull of the -pull repo, or license-pull on an air-gapped instance).

1. WARN0315: the licence expires within warn-days (default 30) of the end of its expiry month
2. WARN0316: the licence has expired but is within the 2-month renewal grace — full function, renew before enforcement
3. ERR00122: the renewal grace has elapsed (or the plugin was built without a URI) — enforcement applies

config_keys.label: Warn days before expiry
config_keys.help: Days before the end of the licence's expiry month to raise WARN0315.
